contract_census.freeze_rule: Freeze sorted unique contract tickers and metadata hashes from the first complete successful response to the fixed listing slot. No substitute later listing if that slot is missing.
contract_census.missing_snapshot: One failed polling slot remains failed even if a later slot supplies evidence. A missing listing census blocks operational success.
contract_census.required_complete_response: Nested market collection present, no cursor/truncation, every contract belongs to expected event/series, each has unique ticker and supported greater predicate. A missing field is not an empty collection.
contract_census.subsequent_census: Every later complete event receipt must have the same ticker set and unchanged station/source/time/strike/predicate/rule fields. Preserve additions, removals and changes; classify census_changed and block admission, rather than dropping contracts.

identity_rules.duplicate_rule: Identical relevant observation rows collapse with all source indexes; conflicting rows within one response are quarantined, not chosen by value/status.
identity_rules.expected_open_time: target-1hour; any difference retained as listing-window mismatch, not repaired
identity_rules.non_target_values: No earlier/later minute, hourly average, station alias, daily max or METAR substitution.
identity_rules.report_time_local: Retain display string verbatim; if it includes an offset or explicit zone and is parseable without guessing, require agreement. An ambiguous display string does not override reportTimeUTC/localDate/localHour/timezone.
identity_rules.source_clock: Retain provider fetchedAt separately from request-start/actual-received times. Use local receipt for availability. Impossible/future provider clocks are clock_anomaly; never repair receipt time to provider time.
identity_rules.source_metadata: Require expected requested weekStart/weekEnd/dates, one KAUS station object, row ICAO match and source label live; any changed source label/product schema is source_changed, not a renamed equivalent.
identity_rules.ticker_clock: Expected ticker derives from America/New_York; actual metadata must confirm. Never parse ticker as Austin local time.
identity_rules.twc_clock: reportTimeUTC exactly target; icaoId KAUS at station and row; timezone America/Chicago; localDate/localHour/fold must agree with UTC conversion. reportTimeLocal retained verbatim.

missed_deadline: Abort this calendar; no rolling dates, neighboring hours or station substitution. A later calendar requires a new declaration before its measurements/outcomes are read.

numeric_comparator.decimal_policy: Parse numeric token/string as exact finite Decimal; retain original lexeme and JSON pointer/byte span. Compare tempF directly to numeric expiration_value with equality tolerance0. No rounding, Celsius substitution or temperature conversion.
numeric_comparator.first_determination_cutoff: Earliest local receipt with status determined or finalized in any frozen-census contract. This is a local evidence cutoff only, not the legal expiration time. A TWC row first captured after this cutoff cannot establish the primary comparison.
numeric_comparator.known_lifecycle: Use exact observed strings determined/finalized; only finalized with result yes/no supports ordinary-binary numeric comparison. Unknown, disputed/review, scalar or fair-price resolutions remain explicit unsupported cases.
numeric_comparator.market_version: First finalized ordinary-binary version for every contract in the frozen event census; retain later revisions and any inconsistency.
numeric_comparator.numeric_missing: Absent/non-numeric expiration_value is not zero; return predicate_only_consistent or predicate_conflict when ordinary binary constraints exist, otherwise missing.
numeric_comparator.partial_numeric: If any contract lacks numeric expiration_value, report predicate-only evidence plus the available numeric comparisons; never mark event exact_match. A numeric or predicate contradiction always overrides a missing-only status.
numeric_comparator.predicate: For every contract, strict Decimal(expiration_value)>Decimal(floor_strike) must equal result==yes. Only strike_type=greater supported in this audit.
numeric_comparator.predicate_interval: Intersect (K,+infinity) for YES and (-infinity,K] for NO. Preserve open/closed endpoints; never use midpoint as an observed label.
numeric_comparator.primary_twc_version: First locally received unique exact-hour row with status=settled, captured no later than first locally observed exchange determination/finalization. Pending/future-valid rows cannot supply the primary numeric comparator.
numeric_comparator.twc_predicate: Also compare the primary tempF candidate against every ordinary binary predicate; retain numeric equality and predicate agreement separately. Any contradiction prevents exact_match.

polling_proposal.before_target: Archive bytes append-only, but do not normalize target numerical measurement or outcome fields before target UTC. Prior-target request checks source metadata/status only. Never expose a future-valid value as an observed label.
polling_proposal.missed_slots: Retain not_attempted; never replay missed observation times. A response later than its slot is late evidence, never backdated.
polling_proposal.retry_policy: GET only; at most two retries for specified transient statuses or transport timeouts; archive each failed attempt. Honor Retry-After with minimum1second. If a retry cannot start within the original slot start deadline, record exhausted/missed rather than shift the schedule. A global hard stop or byte cap never gets extended.
polling_proposal.revision_window: Complete every fixed slot through target+24h even after a preliminary match. Admission remains blocked until the last target revision window ends and all gates are checked.
polling_proposal.shared_collector: One separately registered acquisition collector with source-readiness capture; union coincident URL/query slots and retain all logical purposes against the same actual receipt. Do not duplicate GETs. Budgets here are mapping-only upper bounds, not the shared collector total.
polling_proposal.shared_receipt_eligibility: The shared collector registration must pin its full union cadence before access. All its already-received matching TWC snapshots belong to the first-seen/version ledger, including readiness purposes; never select a favorable subset of shared receipts.

quantile_information.inclusive_interval: P(a<=Y<=b) lies in[max(0,L_F(b)-U_G(a)),min(1,U_F(b)-L_G(a))] under the forecast quantile constraints
quantile_information.meaning: Model-resolution bounds, not statistical confidence bounds or identified source precision; empty/inconsistent constraints fail rather than selecting favorable interpolation
quantile_information.role: Prospective probability representation only; no scores/fits in this audit
quantile_information.unknown_atoms: Keep equality mass uncertain; do not assert no atom at a strike or invent reporting grid from8samples

result_schema.expected_final_status: All eight cases initially unobserved; status enums below apply only once an audit has actual evidence. No outcomes are expected or filled by this design.
result_schema.missing_rules: Missing row/station, null/nonfinite numeric, pending status at cutoff, missing listing, unknown operator/source, conflicting duplicate, incomplete/reviewed event, or absent publication/cutoff evidence each retains its own reason. No case is removed from denominator8.

revision_rules.as_of_expiration: Record expiration_time, expected_expiration_time, settlement_ts and first determination/finalization receipts separately. Until authoritative effective cutoff and source version-publication timing are known, as-of-expiration semantics remain unresolved.
revision_rules.numeric_change: Any captured changed settled tempF or changed finalized expiration/result is revision_sensitive and blocks paper use pending separate review; do not select a matching version retrospectively.
revision_rules.pending_to_settled: Retain transition even with same number; not an independent match
revision_rules.post_cutoff: Clearly proven post-effective-expiration changes excluded from legal resolution only with authoritative cutoff evidence; still retained. Changes after24h are unobserved, not proved absent.
revision_rules.version_key: station,target,status,tempF numeric value; preserve representation-only changes separately; fetchedAt/request time changes alone do not add independent observations

twc.parse_only_utc_hours: the exact eight target_utc values; other station-hour measurement fields remain unnormalized

authoritative_semantic_evidence_needed: measurement window/aggregation and UTC label convention
effective expiration cutoff and allowed correction source/version rules
success_gates.earlier_paper_cases: Any paper decision before audit completion and affirmative gates remains blocked on its original schedule. No preliminary-eight-match shortcut, calendar rolling or post-outcome reissued forecast.
success_gates.later_mismatch_stop: Persist global no-new-entry flag before evaluating another signal; cancel any resting-paper intents, retain reservations until terminal state, keep held positions and all losses under previously frozen maturity rules; no automatic resume or alternative source/rounding switch.
success_gates.operational_consistency: All8 identity_confirmed + exact_match + finalized_complete; zero revision_sensitive, conflicts or missing cases. This is8observed matches only.
success_gates.paper_admission: Requires separate affirmative authoritative semantic verification AND operational8/8 AND no unresolved revision/census/maturity gap. Eight matches alone cannot authorize paper trades.
success_gates.success_dimensions: Report identity, numeric/predicate, revision, maturity and semantic axes independently. A numeric mismatch is a comparison failure, not a proven exchange error; label choice, publication versions or rule interpretation may be wrong.
